description: The agent must: (1) Read all company data files in /workspace/company_data/ to understand Shunda Logistics' profile (120 employees, logistics/warehousing, pain points across 6 departments). (2) Apply the 5-step enterprise AI diagnosis workflow from SKILL.md: enterprise assessment → AI value analysis → ROI calculation → implementation planning → execution checklist. (3) Generate /workspace/reports/final/ai_diagnosis_report.md containing: an enterprise assessment section; AI applicability scores from 0-100 for each major business process/department (the proprietary trap: scores must be numeric 0-100, not qualitative); a full ROI section with BOTH cost breakdown (tools+training+time) AND benefit breakdown (labor savings+efficiency gains+error reduction) plus a payback period prediction; an implementation plan split into EXACTLY the three phases defined in SKILL.md (1-2 weeks / 1 month / 3 months); tool recommendations categorized as free/low-cost/professional; a Week-1 execution checklist with actionable bullet items; and a risk section. The report must be in proper Markdown with ≥5 headers and contain quantitative monetary/percentage figures. An agent without SKILL.md knowledge would produce a generic report missing the 0-100 scoring system, the specific three-phase plan structure, the free/low-cost/professional tool categorization, and the dual cost+benefit breakdown required for the ROI calculation.
